item.title: Wedding strike exposes US savagery: Expediency Council chief
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Head of Iran’s Expediency Council Ayatollah Sadegh Amoli Larijani has condemned the US strike in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, calling the killing of women and children a war crime that exposes Washington’s hypocrisy on human rights.

item.title: Baqaei: Reducing raison d'être of UN to preventing war between superpowers is dangerous
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says that reducing the raison d'être of the United Nations to "preventing war between superpowers" is a misleading and dangerous interpretation of the spirit of the Charter and the fundamental principle prohibiting the use of force in relations among all states (Article 2, Paragraph 4).

item.title: UN chief gravely concerned by renewed US-Iran exchange of fire: Spokesperson
item.description: New York, IRNA – UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said on Wednesday during a news conference that "I can tell the secretary-general is gravely concerned by the renewed exchange of fire overnight between the United States and the Islamic Republic of Iran. The secretary-general is deeply alarmed by reports of civilian casualties, including a strike that reportedly hit a wedding ceremony in Iran."
